Name: Kenneth's Confectionery
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Adds 32 candies, chocolates and sweets to Kenneth's Dessert Shop - pale yellow gumball, single chocolate chunk, blueberry taffy wrap, peppermint swirl lollipop, grape purple lollipop, peppermint candy disc, cherry fish candy, chocolate chew candy, dark chocolate truffle, rainbow fruit taffy wrap, mini chocolate swiss roll, bitten chocolate cookie, bitten chocolate bar, dark cocoa sandwich cookie, red pacifier candy, watermelon candy wrap, apple pacifier candy, confetti sugar cookie, sour green gummy worm, blue and red wrapped candies, red wrapped milk chocolate wafer bar, chocolate wafer log, colorful sugar squares, trio of candy gems, red gummy bear, caramel apple lollipop, classic candy corn, double chocolate chip cookie, blue crystal rock candy, strawberry sprinkle donut, wrapped milk chocolate bar, and rainbow swirl lollipop - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b]

[b]This mod does not add a new shop or map, it adds items to Kenneth's Dessert Shop. Items are sold across its 3 shops. Requires Kenneth's Dessert Shop to work.[/b]

[b]Customization: by default all candies appear in the shops. If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can disable individual items to remove them from the shops along with their recipes. Re-enabling restores them.[/b]

[b]More details can be found in ReadMe.txt. Please do not reupload or include in modpacks without permission.[/b]

[b]Note: this is the small-candy collection with 32 items and is complete. No additional candies will be added here.[/b]
